steps.description:
Game programming is what attracts many young coders to start their coding journey because it sounds fun. It is, however, one of the more challenging fields to master, if you are talking about a professional game. There many related areas of study to acquire before you can independently create a game. But everything starts from the small steps and learning along the way. In fact, you have actually done some along the way!

Randomness is one of the indispensable features for game development because it gives an element of surprise. We learnt about the Random block that generates a random number. Below are some ways to use it.


Soon, you’ll learn about variables, which will allow you to check random numbers more effectively.


Reflex games are a lot of fun and surprisingly easy to create. In the example below, two sticks "|" shift randomly along separate rows every 0.5 seconds while you hold down a button. Your goal is to release the button the moment the sticks align in the same column. Once the button is released, the game pauses for 2 seconds so you can see the final positions. 


Create the game. You can adjust the speed to ramp up the challenge and even compete with friends to see who has the fastest reflexes!

Remember, you can use Comment blocks or a simple flow diagram to plan your program sequence.
